issues.description: The problem statement's UML declares ExcellenceLand.excellencyLevel as type float, but the solution implementation declares excellencyLevel as double. This type mismatch across artifacts can confuse students about which primitive type to use in the constructor and getter, and may cause signature/typing mismatches in tests or when students follow the specification exactly.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the type of excellencyLevel consistent across artifacts. Either update the problem statement (and UML) to use double, or modify the solution (and template) to use float for excellencyLevel and adjust the constructor and getter signatures accordingly. Prefer updating the solution/template to float to match the UML if the UML/statement is authoritative.
